cards.text: Elisha, prophet of the LORD, hears a woman crying out to him. She's the wife of one of the sons of the prophets, and her husband has died. She reminds Elisha that he knows her husband feared the LORD.

cards.question: Now trouble is on the way for this widow. Her husband's ___ is coming to take her two children as his slaves.

cards.text: Elisha asks, “How can I help you?” and then wants to know what she has in the house. Friend, I know that question, and I know the move: pat the apron, check the pockets, and hope something shows up.

cards.question: Elisha wants to know what the widow has in the house. What does she have?

cards.text: Elisha sends her out to her neighbors to borrow something. If I had to knock on doors asking for stuff, friend, I'd be apologizing to the doormat by house two.

cards.question: What does Elisha tell the widow to borrow from her neighbors?
Elisha tells the widow that a few empty jars will be plenty.

cards.text: Go inside, he says, shut the door behind you and your sons, and pour into all those jars. So she does: her sons keep bringing jars, and she keeps pouring, and pouring, and POURING.

cards.question: The widow's oil keeps flowing until every last borrowed jar is full.

cards.text: Her son tells her there are no more jars, and the oil stops flowing. I've packed a LOT of cookie boxes, friend, and the cookies always run out before the boxes do, NEVER the other way around.

cards.question: The widow goes and tells Elisha. His orders: sell the oil, pay your ___, and live on the ___.

cards.text: One day Elisha goes to Shunem, where a prominent woman persuades him to have a meal. Nobody has EVER had to persuade me to eat, friend, I'm already holding the plate.

cards.question: After that first meal in Shunem, Elisha never stops by the woman's house again.

cards.text: Then she tells her husband, “Behold, now I know that the one who often comes our way is a holy man of God.” And she's got an idea.

cards.question: The woman from Shunem asks her husband to help make a small ___ upstairs for the holy man of God.

cards.text: The room gets a bed, a table, a chair and a lamp, and one day Elisha comes and lies down up there. Friend, after years in the back of a junk drawer, a room with its own LAMP sounds like a palace to me.
Elisha has Gehazi, his servant, call her in, then asks through Gehazi what they can do for her after all her trouble. Maybe a word with the king, or with the commander of the army?

cards.question: The woman from Shunem asks Elisha to put in a good word for her with the king.
Elisha asks Gehazi what should be done for the woman instead. What does Gehazi point out?

answers.text: She has no son and an old husband
Her fields have had no rain
Her family owes a large debt

cards.text: Gehazi calls her back, and she stands in the doorway. Elisha declares, “At this time next year, you will hold a son in your arms.”

cards.question: How does the woman from Shunem respond to Elisha's promise of a son?

answers.text: She asks him not to lie to her
She laughs to herself about it
She runs to tell her husband

cards.question: At that time the next year, the woman gives birth to a son, just as Elisha said.

cards.text: The child grows, and one day he heads out to his father, who's in the field with the harvesters. Then the boy complains to his father, “My head! My head!”

cards.question: Out in the field, the boy's father tells a servant to carry him to his ___.

cards.text: The servant carries him home, and the boy sits on his mother's lap until noon. And then he dies.

cards.question: Where does the boy's mother lay him?

answers.text: On the man of God's bed
In the field by his father

cards.text: She shuts the door and goes out. Then she asks her husband for a servant and a donkey so she can go quickly to the man of God and come back.
Her husband asks, “Why would you go to him today?” It's not a New Moon or a Sabbath.

cards.question: Her husband wants to know why she's going to the man of God today. What does she tell him?

answers.text: The man of God sent for me

cards.text: She saddles the donkey and tells her servant, “Drive onward; do not slow the pace for me unless I tell you.” I think every mile feels long to her.
Elisha spots her in the distance at Mount Carmel. He sends Gehazi running to ask if she, her husband and her child are all right.
And her answer? That line again: “Everything is all right.”

cards.question: The woman reaches Elisha and clings to his feet, and Gehazi comes over to push her away. What does Elisha do?

answers.text: He tells Gehazi to leave her alone
He lets Gehazi lead her away
He tells her to go home and wait

cards.question: Elisha says the LORD has already told him what's troubling the woman.

cards.text: Then she says, “Did I ask you for a son, my lord? Didn’t I say, ‘Do not deceive me?’”

cards.question: Elisha tells Gehazi to tie up his garment and go. Gehazi is to take Elisha's ___ and lay it on the boy's face.
Elisha tells Gehazi to greet everyone he meets along the way.
Elisha gives Gehazi his orders. Then what does the boy's mother tell Elisha?

cards.text: So Elisha gets up and follows her, and Gehazi goes on ahead of them.

cards.question: When Gehazi lays the staff on the boy's face, there is no sound or response.

cards.text: Gehazi goes back and tells Elisha, “The boy has not awakened.” When Elisha reaches the house, there's the boy, lying dead on his bed.

cards.question: Elisha goes in and closes the door behind himself and the boy. What does he do next?

cards.text: Then Elisha gets on the bed and lies on the boy, mouth to mouth, eye to eye and hand to hand.

cards.question: As Elisha stretches himself out over him, the boy's body becomes ___.

cards.text: Elisha turns away and paces back and forth across the room. Then he gets back on the bed and stretches himself out over the boy again.

cards.question: Elisha has stretched himself out over the boy a second time. What does the boy do?

answers.text: The boy sneezes seven times and opens his eyes
The boy sits up and calls for his mother
The boy groans and asks for his father

cards.text: SEVEN sneezes, friend, that's not a sneeze, that's a drumroll. Then Elisha has Gehazi call the Shunammite woman, and when she comes he says, “Pick up your son.”

cards.question: Before she picks up her son, the woman falls at Elisha's feet and bows to the ground.

cards.text: Then she picks up her son and goes out. I bet if anybody asks her now whether everything is all right, she's got a WHOLE new answer.
